---
title: "Research data sharing: a scoping review (RDS-Review)"
---

RDS-Review maps the factors reported to influence the sharing and reuse of research data, including barriers, facilitators, and governance mechanisms. It centres on health research data and compares it with research data sharing in other fields.

Its taxonomy of factors will support manual annotation for supervised machine learning in the [CITF-emails](https://zackbatist.info/CITF-emails/) study.

::: {.callout-note}
## Status
Draft protocol. The protocol is not yet registered, and the eligibility criteria and limits can still change. See the [Research Protocol](research-protocol.qmd).
:::

This website hosts the protocol, the codebook, the search and screening materials, and the notebooks that produce the counts, tables, and PRISMA flow diagram. Everything is tracked at [github.com/zackbatist/RDS-Review](https://github.com/zackbatist/RDS-Review).

| Page | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Research Protocol](research-protocol.qmd) | Background, questions, eligibility criteria, methods, and open decisions |
| [Codebook](codebook.qmd) | The charting form, with each variable and its allowed values |
| [Search strategy](materials/search-strategy.qmd) | Databases, search strings, dates, counts, and the known-item test |
| [Screening guide](materials/screening-guide.qmd) | Screening stages, criteria, exclusion reasons, and export formats |
| [Checklists](materials/checklists/index.qmd) | PRISMA-ScR and PRISMA-S, with the location of each item |
